description: This file defines the StreamPerPartitionDataAdapter class, which extends EventHubDataAdapter for handling event hub stream positions, specifically for per-partition event hub stream provider testing in Orleans.

classes.name: StreamPerPartitionDataAdapter
classes.description: A data adapter for event hub streams that handles stream position retrieval for per-partition event hub streams in Orleans.

methods.name: StreamPerPartitionDataAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for StreamPerPartitionDataAdapter, initializing with a serializer.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Returns the stream position for a given partition and event data, constructing a StreamPosition with a stream ID and sequence token.

methods.name: GetPartitionGuid
methods.description: Generates a GUID from a partition string by encoding it to bytes, resizing, and constructing a GUID from the hash code and byte array.
